title: CVE-2026-63569 — MTI/A0 DHAgreement does not validate the peer's ephemeral value
summary: Affected: Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. bc-csharp Improper input validation in DHAgreement.CalculateAgreement (MTI/A0 two-pass Diffie-Hellman) in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. bc-csharp before 2.7.0 allows an on-path attacker to make the local party compute an agreed value the attacker already knows, defeating the key authentication MTI/A0 is meant to provide. It also allows a malicious peer to learn the local static private key modulo the small factors of p-1, and to recover it entirely in groups with many such factors. The attack uses a crafted out-of-range or small-order ephemeral value, and works because that value is raised to the static private key without the range and subgroup-membership checks applied to DH public keys. Only applications that call DHAgreement directly are affected.

title: CVE-2014-125138 — C97net qEngine CMS through 6.0.0, Kemana Directory through 1.5.6, Cart Engine through 3.0.0 Unrestricted File Upload vi…
summary: Affected: C97net qEngine CMS, C97net Kemana Directory, C97net Cart Engine C97net qEngine CMS through 6.0.0, Kemana Directory through 1.5.6, and Cart Engine through 3.0.0 contain an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in administrative image fields. Editor-role users can upload PHP scripts via the page_image or cat_image parameters to the web-accessible /public/image directory and request them to execute code on the server.

title: CVE-2014-125137 — C97net qEngine CMS through 6.0.0, Kemana Directory through 1.5.6, Cart Engine through 3.0.0 Local File Inclusion via ad…
summary: Affected: C97net qEngine CMS, C97net Kemana Directory, C97net Cart Engine C97net qEngine CMS through 6.0.0, Kemana Directory through 1.5.6, and Cart Engine through 3.0.0 contain a local file inclusion vulnerability in the run parameter of admin/task.php. Authenticated administrators can supply directory traversal sequences in the run parameter to include and disclose local files readable by the web server.

title: CVE-2026-118374 — LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 Memory Exhaustion via Unbounded OCSP HTTP Response
summary: Affected: OpenBSD LibreSSL LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows malicious OCSP responders to exhaust memory by sending unbounded HTTP responses. Attackers controlling the responder or intercepting plain HTTP AIA OCSP traffic can stream endless headers or body data to http_head_read() and http_body_read(), denying certificate status checks.

title: CVE-2026-118373 — LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 Cleartext Transmission of OCSP Requests via url2host()
summary: Affected: OpenBSD LibreSSL LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability because url2host() discards the OCSP URL scheme and http_alloc() only selects TLS for port 443. On-path network attackers can read OCSP requests sent to https responder URLs on non-443 ports, exposing certificate serial numbers, issuer hashes, and nonces.

title: CVE-2026-118372 — LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 CRLF Injection via AIA OCSP URL Path
summary: Affected: OpenBSD LibreSSL LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject HTTP headers by embedding CR/LF sequences in a certificate's AIA OCSP URI path. Because url2host() copies the path without rejecting control characters and http_open() places it in the POST request line, attackers can inject headers or split OCSP requests sent to the responder host.
